source.author: verg
source.text: Nascetur pulchra Troianus origine Caesar, imperium oceano, famam qui terminet astris, Iulius, a magno demissum nomen Iulo.
source.text_original: Nascetur pulchra Troianus origine Caesar, / imperium oceano, famam qui terminet astris, — / Iulius, a magno demissum nomen Iulo.
source.text_english: A Trojan Caesar will be born from a beautiful line, Julius, a name descended from great Iulus, who shall bound his rule by the ocean, his fame by the stars.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: unde etiam Christi uirgo, filia eius, Eustochium Iulia nuncupatur et ipse Iulius, a magno demissum nomen Iulo.
reuse.text_original: unde etiam Christi uirgo, filia eius, Eustochium Iulia nuncupatur et ipse Iulius, a magno demissum nomen Iulo.
reuse.text_english: whence also the virgin of Christ, his daughter, Eustochium, is called Julia, and he himself Julius, a name descended from great Iulus.
